answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The ocean holds work receipts rather than names, so the summit of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
